scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Generate a unique random secret with at least 32 bytes of entropy. Never use the example value.

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: The exact HTTPS origin of the deployed Worker, such as https://cloudmail.example.workers.dev.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: The email address of the installation administrator. Leave empty until ready to register.

AUTH_EMAIL_FROM.description: A sender address on a domain enabled in Cloudflare Email Service.

ENABLE_SIGNUP.description: Set to true only when your sending domain is ready and you want to allow account registration.

DB.description: D1 database for authentication, email history, templates, and delivery events.

INBOUND.description: Private R2 bucket for received email, scheduled messages, and sent message bodies.
